_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate plus flat funding, neutral CVD, and F&G in 47-54 make HOLD the skilled call until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is Complacency/HOLD/CAUTION; narrative had no forward phase or direction (commodity print only).
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-54 and BTC stays rangebound with funding near flat and no volatility-expansion break
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed leaves 47-54 on a decisive BTC break, with ETF flows firmly positive (up) or funding flipping negative on a sharp sell (down)
